What's new in Vekrun 0.4.4 — Vekrun on a Linux server

• Run Vekrun without its window on a Linux server: the command line, the background worker and the MCP server work with no desktop and no OS keychain. Opt in to an owner-only secret store (VEKRUN_SECRET_STORE=file) and Vekrun keeps keys as files only you can read — and refuses them if anyone else can. See docs/headless.md for the setup.
• A Linux machine can prove work on its own isolation engine — podman, gVisor, Kata, QEMU or Firecracker — with vekrun anywhere use local.
• The worker's systemd service now remembers the data folder and secret store it was set up with, and runs with tighter defaults.
• Fixed: an agent working through the Execution Bridge could wait up to 30 minutes for a reply whose last bytes never arrived on some Linux kernels. Replies now arrive whole, and faster.
